metadata.name: GetPendingDisputeTransactionHistory
metadata.description: This API is used to Get Pending Dispute Transaction History.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Currency Code Ex. 840 = US Doller. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language ==  en: means use English ---- es: means Spanish Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Description: Unique identification number for Institution Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumberLast4Digit
request_fields.description: Description: Last 4 digits of card number Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: XXXX Example: 1234 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: FromDate
request_fields.description: Description: Starting date of transaction search.Used as a criteria for Transaction Filter. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: MMDDYYY Example: 02012020

request_fields.name: ToDate
request_fields.description: Description: End date of transaction search.Used as a criteria for Transaction Filter Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: MMDDYYY Example: 02012020

children.name: PendingDisputeTransactionList
children.description: List all the dispute transactions.

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 23654789

children.name: DisputeAutoResolveDate
children.description: Date on which Dispute is marked as Resolved. Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Example: 20200202122000

children.name: TransactionPostTime
children.description: Actual time when transaction was posted. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 09/09/201 21:09:10

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9 Example: Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionCurrencyCode
children.description: Currency code of Transaction amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX Example: 840 Allowable Values: 3

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Amount of Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: TransactionSource
children.description: Ttransaction source like ACH, manual etc Valid Values: Please refer Format: X or XX Example: 5=IPM, For  Retail =29(Installment Purchase) Retail =39(Credit Purchase)  Retail=23 (Manual Auth) Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CardAcceptorNameLocation
children.description: Merchant name and location Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CardNumberLast4Digits
children.description: Last 4 digits of card number Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 1234 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: DisputeStatus
children.description: Status of disputed transaction. Example: Resolve in favor of Cardholder Allowable Values: 2

children.name: DisputeInitiateDate
children.description: Date on which Dispute is raised for the Transaction. Format:Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Example: 20200202122000

children.name: LastUpdatedDate
children.description: Date when the record was last updated. Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Example: 20200507082705

children.name: DisputeAmount
children.description: The amount for which the Dispute is raised on the Transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 20.00

children.name: UserID
children.description: User ID of the user who take action on the dispute case. Example: DisputeAdminOne Allowable Values: 65

children.name: MerchantID
children.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345

children.name: DisputeReason
children.description: Reason through which Dispute resolution needs to take place. Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TokenWalletID
children.description: Token generated at the time of Digital wallet enrollment. Valid Values: 0-1, A-Z Example: 0- any string Token Allowable Values: 4

children.name: TotalRecordCount
children.description: Total number of records in an Array. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10
